scope: DEV ONLY: R5-history-calibrated forecast for exact-XOR width3, mix/partial-CDCL original-CNF fallback; not full SAT autonomy

history.rare_class_support: Exact width3 one SHA; mixed-width4 one SHA; mixed-width5 one SHA; partial width4 one SHA; partial width5 one SHA; cannot claim generalization from one class instance.

locked_cost_model.case_decision_inputs: Only original CNF clauses and n: exact full sign-mask parity proof; width histogram; number of complete/partial groups; residual fraction; equation density; variable support-degree CV; original clause length histogram; no solving, no seed or kind or R6 times.
locked_cost_model.train_predicted_times: Historical median 3/3 SAT_VERIFIED full-cold GF2, CMS native, CMS original, CaDiCaL original from R5; CPU-censored are undefined, never infinite or a fabricated median.
locked_cost_model.scale: prediction at new N = recorded median at source Nref * (N/Nref)^1.5 for GF2, original CMS and CaDiCaL; predicted speedup ratio uses both prior host sample ratios conservatively; no data-driven R6 hyperparameter retuning.
locked_cost_model.full_exact_width_3: If exact all-original XOR width3, equation density 0.8-1.2, support-degree CV 0.25-0.75, n 64-160 and lower-bound across prior 2 hosts of fastest-verified-external/GF2>=1.15, select GF2; else certified CryptoMiniSat native XOR.
locked_cost_model.full_exact_width_4_5: If full cert width4 or width5, eq/n 0.8-1.2, degree-CV 0.25-0.75 and R5 exact width supported on both hosts with lower-bound >=1.25, select GF2; else certified native XOR.
locked_cost_model.full_exact_width_unknown: Only certified native XOR; GF2 must abstain.
locked_cost_model.mixed_width4: If original contains completed parity groups of uniform width4, extra incomplete 3-CNF residual groups, 0.25-0.75 residual clauses per complete parity equation, equation density 0.8-1.2, n 80-180, and R5 original-CMS/CaDiCaL >=1.50 on BOTH hosts, select original-CNF CaDiCaL, else original-CNF CMS.
locked_cost_model.mixed_width5: Select original-CNF CMS: prior R5 CaDiCaL right-censored, no trusted numeric ratio.
locked_cost_model.partial_width4: Only single incomplete parity group with other full width4 masks, complete group fraction >0.97, all clauses width4; if R5 original-CMS/CaDiCaL >=1.30 on BOTH hosts, select CaDiCaL; otherwise CMS original.
locked_cost_model.partial_width5_and_nonXOR: Select original-CNF CMS, never silently discard residual clauses.
locked_cost_model.strict_abstention: Never use GF2 or CMS native XOR if original CNF is not fully exact XOR. No performance imputation from right-censored baseline.
locked_cost_model.feature_budget: <=2500 vars <=35000 clauses <=160000 literal occurrences <=6 literals/row; profile <=2s; exceed => no specialized GF2, fail closed or ordinary bounded original solver with no gain claim.
locked_cost_model.pipeline_FIT_SHA: Rebuild from SHA-pinned R5 training file on both workers and separately in auditor. Every R6 source SHA unique and not among R5 originals.

evaluation.metric: Parent full cold subprocess time: startup+input source SHA/generation+structural model inference+engine initialization/solve+complete original SAT witness replay+output. All statuses retained.
evaluation.correctness: Each SAT model reverified against every original CNF clause. Any missing or wrong model FAIL, never a speedup.
evaluation.abstention: On incomplete/mixed/ordinary CNF native-XOR and own-GF2 ablation are NOT APPLICABLE, not failures. Exact parity only for such arms.

frozen_science_gate.strict_correctness: Selector 3/3 SAT verified on all 12 sources on BOTH hosts.
frozen_science_gate.width3_generalization: Both new exact width3 SHA must reach at least 1.10x vs fastest verified external competitor on BOTH hosts; no more than 10% regret on width6.
frozen_science_gate.width4_and5_transfer: Both new exact width4/5 sources must reach at least 1.20x vs fastest fully verified external competitor on BOTH hosts.
frozen_science_gate.mixed_CNFS: Both NEW mixed-width4 sources must incur at most 5% regret vs fastest fully verified external competitor on BOTH hosts, and all other incomplete/mixed/3CNF cases at most 10% regret.
frozen_science_gate.no_regret: NO source can exceed 10% slowdown against fastest fully verified competitor on either host. Any source without 3/3 SAT receipts means NOT PASSED; never turn timeouts into numeric wins.
frozen_science_gate.secondary_all_comparators: Separate stronger all-applicable external baselines 3/3 completion; any censored applicable arm => strict gate NOT PASSED.
frozen_science_gate.external_blind: Not done on own GitHub; an independent sealed >4-family source cohort and external admin required before Stage5 general SAT claim.
frozen_science_gate.no_self_training: Any parameter change after seeing these R6 sources requires a prospective R7 cohort, not R6 rerun reinterpretation.
